_note: 영어 번역 중 직접 쓴 것 (tools/build_en.py가 PokeAPI 영어 이름·설명과 합쳐 js/lang_en.js를 만든다). items: 도구 이름·설명 / moves·abilities: PokeAPI에 없는 게임 전용

elixir: Restores the PP of all moves.
reviver: Revives you automatically when you faint (restores HP and PP). Can also be used from the bag to revive a fainted ally.
blast: Deals heavy fire damage to the enemy in front (fixed 60).
sleep: Throw it to put the enemy it hits to sleep.
warp: Eat it to warp somewhere on the floor.
stun: Throw it to paralyze the enemy it hits.
thorn: Throw it to deal fixed 25 damage to an enemy.
gravel: Throw it to deal fixed 12 damage to an enemy.
escape: Escapes from the dungeon. You keep your bag.
lumi: Reveals the whole map of this floor.
foesleep: Puts all visible enemies to sleep.
candy: Raises the level by 1. Can also be used from the bag or storage in town.
stone: Needed by Pokémon that evolve with an item. (Use in town)
link: Needed by Pokémon that evolve by trade. (Use in town)
quest: The item a mission asks for.
fullrestore: Fully restores HP and cures status conditions.
xattack: Raises Attack by 2 stages for 300 turns.
xdefense: Raises Defense by 2 stages for 300 turns.
xspatk: Raises Sp. Atk by 2 stages for 300 turns.
xspeed: Raises Speed by 2 stages for 300 turns. (Affects accuracy and evasion)
xaccuracy: Raises accuracy by 2 stages for 300 turns.
poisonseed: Throw it to poison the enemy it hits.
confuseseed: Throw it to confuse the enemy it hits.
goldthorn: Throw it to deal fixed 50 damage to an enemy.
radar: Shows enemies and items on this floor on the minimap.
trapbust: Removes all traps on this floor.
sloworb: Lowers the Speed of all visible enemies by 2 stages.
chesto: Wakes you up and keeps you from falling asleep on this floor.
lum: Cures all status conditions and lowered stats.
leppa: Restores 10 PP to a chosen move.
liechi: Raises Attack by 1 stage for 300 turns.
ganlon: Raises Defense by 1 stage for 300 turns.
petaya: Raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage for 300 turns.
apicot: Raises Sp. Def by 1 stage for 300 turns.
salac: Raises Speed by 1 stage for 300 turns.
starf: Raises a random stat by 2 stages for 300 turns.
lansat: Makes critical hits much more likely for 300 turns (+2 crit stages).
whitegummy: Fills the belly by 15 and raises HP by 2 permanently. Up to 20 times per stat. Eat it in a dungeon or in the town's Character tab. (In roguelike dungeons, only for that run)
redgummy: Fills the belly by 15 and raises Attack by 1 permanently. Up to 20 times per stat. Eat it in a dungeon or in the town's Character tab. (In roguelike dungeons, only for that run)
yellowgummy: Fills the belly by 15 and raises Defense by 1 permanently. Up to 20 times per stat. Eat it in a dungeon or in the town's Character tab. (In roguelike dungeons, only for that run)
bluegummy: Fills the belly by 15 and raises Sp. Atk by 1 permanently. Up to 20 times per stat. Eat it in a dungeon or in the town's Character tab. (In roguelike dungeons, only for that run)
greengummy: Fills the belly by 15 and raises Sp. Def by 1 permanently. Up to 20 times per stat. Eat it in a dungeon or in the town's Character tab. (In roguelike dungeons, only for that run)
pinkgummy: Fills the belly by 15 and raises Speed by 1 permanently. Up to 20 times per stat. Eat it in a dungeon or in the town's Character tab. (In roguelike dungeons, only for that run)
rainbowgummy: Fills the belly by 30 and raises every stat by 1 permanently (HP by 2). Up to 20 times per stat. Eat it in a dungeon or in the town's Character tab. (In roguelike dungeons, only for that run)
abcapsule: Needed to change to another regular Ability. (Use in the town's Character tab)
masterbook: Raises one move's mastery straight to ★10 (max). (Use in the town's Character tab)
eggtm: Teaches one Egg Move of your choice to that Pokémon. (Use in the town's Character tab)
purecrystal: Upgrades one +3 signature item to +4. (Use in Upgrade on the Exchange tab) Received for reaching floor 99 of Purity Tower.
abpatch: Needed to change to the Hidden Ability. (Use in the town's Character tab)
hpup: Raises HP by 4 permanently. Up to 10 times per stat for each Pokémon.
protein: Raises Attack by 2 permanently. Up to 10 times per stat for each Pokémon.
iron: Raises Defense by 2 permanently. Up to 10 times per stat for each Pokémon.
calcium: Raises Sp. Atk by 2 permanently. Up to 10 times per stat for each Pokémon.
zinc: Raises Sp. Def by 2 permanently. Up to 10 times per stat for each Pokémon.
carbos: Raises Speed by 2 permanently. Up to 10 times per stat for each Pokémon.
blacksludge: Natural HP recovery ×2.5 for Poison types. No effect on others.
shellbell: Restores HP equal to 1/8 of the damage dealt.
lifeorb: Move power ×1.3, but loses 1/10 of max HP on each attack.
focussash: Prevents fainting from one hit at full HP. (Does not hold against multi-hit moves)
focusband: 10% chance to endure a fainting hit with 1 HP.
assaultvest: Sp. Def ×1.4. (No status-move restriction in dungeons)
eviolite: Defense and Sp. Def ×1.5 if the Pokémon can still evolve.
rockyhelmet: Enemies that make contact take 1/6 of their max HP. (Cannot be held with Abilities that damage on contact, such as Rough Skin or Iron Barbs)
loadeddice: Multi-hit moves (2–5 hits) hit at least 4 times. Moves that hit up to 10 times also hit at least 4 times.
quickclaw: 10% chance to act once more after acting.
xrayspecs: Enemies and items on the floor always show on the minimap. (Leader only)
staminaband: The belly empties at half speed. (Leader only)
flameorb: Burns the holder every 5 turns (if it has no status). No burn damage while held. (Pairs well with Guts)
toxicorb: Poisons the holder every 5 turns (if it has no status). No poison damage while held. (Pairs well with Poison Heal or Guts)
friendbow: Defeated enemies want to join ×1.5 as often. (Leader only)
healribbon: Status conditions wear off in half the time.
goldribbon: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed ×1.1.
trapscarf: Traps you step on do not trigger. (Leader only)

2001: Slashes the foe in front and the two diagonal tiles beside it (3 tiles) at once. Typeless, so type matchups do not apply.
2002: Slashes every foe around (within 3 tiles) with a vacuum blade. Low power, but typeless, so type matchups do not apply.

311: When hit by a damaging move, burns the attacker.
312: Floats off the ground, so Ground-type moves miss. Knocking out a foe with a move raises its highest stat.
314: Halves damage taken from contact moves.
